description: Least-privilege role for the observability write-path integrations (Fluent Bit log shipper, cluster-health collector, Data Prepper). Grants write/create/manage only on the observability index patterns, plus the cluster perms those tools need (templates, ISM policies, ingest pipelines, cluster health) and a read-only cluster-wide alias lookup (Data Prepper's sink init scans aliases across all indices). NOT admin. See setup-observability-user.sh.
